title: Low-degree Fourier regularity
statement: For a real number $\varepsilon$, a natural number $k$, and a real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube of length $n$, say that $f$ is Fourier regular through degree $k$ at level $\varepsilon$ if every nonempty subset $S$ of the coordinate indices with $|S|\le k$ satisfies $|\widehat f(S)|\le\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube of length $n$
